answer: Mass registration burns one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent forfeits only once. Registration presupposes a proof of work of 26 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the quill. The identity then has to pass a hollow challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next ridge. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. That is 30 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
